subject: melt a list containing empty element

messages.author: 2ebebe92fdad0c9e
messages.subject: melt a list containing empty element
parts:
Dear group, 

Seems melt or melt.list doesn´t handle the case when a list contains empty entry. Say a list called "A" with the first position empty; is there more convenient option in "melt" to remove the empty cell instead of manually removing it by: melt.list(A[laply(A, function(x) length(x) >0)]) ? 

Thanks,
Xi


> A = list("pos1" = character(0), "pos2" = c(1,2,3,4), "pos3" = rnorm(2))
> A
$pos1
character(0)

$pos2
[1] 1 2 3 4

$pos3
[1] -1.150942  1.106445

> melt(A)
Error in `[[<-.data.frame`(`*tmp*`, var, value = "pos1") : 
  replacement has 1 rows, data has 0

> melt.list(A[laply(A, function(x) length(x) >0)])

Please use reshape2 which correctly handles this case.

Hadley
